item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong moderating gradually, the weather will be relatively humid over the region in the next couple of days. It will be warm during the day. Another easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southeastern China towards the weekend. It will be windier over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China early next week. Besides, the northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong midweek next week. The weather will become appreciably cooler over the region.
